label: About
title: About Blush Chain Observatory
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 77 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 5 and AVANTGAYNFTCOREPORTER (@avantgayALPHA) on X, plus 7 more. A source image from archive.org helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Blush Chain Observatory: Blush chain observatory, poster crop, side-lit object slab: a pale pink cover-field carries heavy illegible black masses across the upper half like optical shutters. Below, one glossy red-orange bag/card-pack slab tilts forward with sharp triangular fold cuts as source apertures. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against glossy red folded triangular slab, matte black torn headline canopy, and gold chain loops and star glints.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
